# MERP-UI 2.0.7 — Talents & Flaws and Compendium Typography

This stable update consolidates two Foundry-tested visual improvements for Rolemaster Unified (RMU).

### Always-visible Talents & Flaws in character creation
- The **Talents & Flaws** step is accessible to every new character, **even if their Race grants no automatic Talent or Flaw**.
- The creation order remains **Knacks → Talents & Flaws → Combat Training** in both directions.
- When there are no racial Talents, an informative panel offers one-click access to the **MERP-RMU — Talents & Flaws** Compendium. The existing native RMU Talent table remains authoritative when present.
- Text follows MERP-UI's independent **Content Language** (French or English) and uses compact **PragRoman** typography aligned with the surrounding RMU character-creation panels.
- No Talent is granted automatically. RMU remains responsible for Talent purchases and Development Point costs.

### Unified typography across the nine MERP-RMU Compendiums
- Folder and document titles share the same **PragRoman** scale and proportional vertical spacing, using **Languages** as the visual reference.
- Native document thumbnails are sized relative to the text so they no longer force oversized lines in **Skills** and other Compendiums.
- Rows are **content-driven**, not fixed-height; longer names still wrap as needed. Folder backgrounds and hierarchy remain distinct.
- This is display-only. Compendium LevelDB contents are not rewritten.

### Compatibility and safety
- **Foundry VTT 13–14**; author-tested on **V14.370** with **Rolemaster Unified 1.4.99**.
- All nine persistent LevelDB Compendiums, bilingual source material and existing MERP-UI 2.0.6 lightweight Actor protections are retained.
- No automatic migration or changes to existing Actors, Journals, Scenes, Development Points or RMU mechanics.

### Install
Use the [Foundry module manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blackbiji/merp-ui/main/module.json) to install or update MERP-UI, or download the **full** `merp-ui-2.0.7.zip` asset attached to this release. The ZIP includes all nine LevelDB Compendiums.

This is an unofficial, free, non-commercial fan project. See `NOTICE.md` for third-party rights and font licences.
